title: HPL3/SOMA/Areas/AgentRepel Area
wikitext:
== Overview ==
This area type repels AI creatures who enter it, that is, it encourages any agent to leave the area.

== Properties ==
=== AgentRepel ===
* '''ExitArea''': A [[HPL3/Areas/Trigger Area | Trigger Area]] for the agent to navigate torwards if the agent enters this area
